bullets.title: REBUS and the Anarchic Brain
bullets.note: This one gets pretty technical, but if you’re interested in models of how the brain might work, how we assemble reality, and so on, this might tickle your fancy.

bullets.title: Max Planck
bullets.note: Max Karl Ernst Ludwig Planck (1858–1947) is the originator of modern quantum theories and one of the most important German physicists of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, winning the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1918. I’m particularly fond of perusing [his incredible and often wild quotes](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh30w85uv/rnt8hoh7v9o5p8/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcXVvdGUub3JnL3dpa2kvTWF4X1BsYW5jaw==).

bullets.title: Remember Shakti: Bell'Alla prt 2
bullets.note: I’ve developed a keen interest in hand percussion, and this video is one hell of a showcase. As one professional drummer friend put it, “They’re both heavy, heavy cats. Total masters. I’ve watched that clip dozens of times. No joke.” [Zakir Hussain](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh30w85uv/l9sehmh4v5dkg0/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvWmFraXJfSHVzc2Fpbl8obXVzaWNpYW4p)’s facial expressions when he’s shredding (in the blue shirt) are priceless. If you’d like a cool overview of the tabla, plus another ripping solo, [check this out](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh30w85uv/d7aeh0hkwz273o/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1Kb3lrX0VNdHpuMA==).

Chase is an entrepreneur, award-winning artist, and one of the most influential photographers of the past decade, having created campaigns for Apple, Nike, Red Bull, and many others. He was a contributor to the Pulitzer Prize-winning _New York Times_ story “Snowfall,” and he earned an Emmy nomination for his documentary _Portrait of a City_. Chase also created Best Camera—the first photo app to share images to social networks—and he is the founder of [CreativeLive](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh30w85uv/rga8hoh7v9o58x/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY3JlYXRpdmVsaXZlLmNvbS8=), where more than 10 million students learn photography, video, design, music, and business from the world’s top creators and entrepreneurs.

bullets.title: “To the economically illiterate, if some company makes a million dollars in profit, this means that their products cost a million dollars more than they would have cost without profits. It never occurs to such people that these products might cost several million dollars more to produce than if they were produced by enterprises operating without the incentives to be efficient created by the prospect of profits.” — Thomas Sowell [](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavh30w85uv/ldhehmh4v5dkgq/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvV2lsbGlhbV9Db3dwZXI=)
